independence: Actual original snapshot, frozen target, warm-soft reference and original native collection inspected before any editor rationale or another object's aesthetic criteria.

observations.original: Tall, dense green branching ribbon kelp rooted into cobalt blue reef rubble. Tips are stepped, sharp and mechanically zigzagged; several fronds visually merge into a dark central knot. Blue base forms remain distinguishable. The source is native mesh geometry with a zero-origin identity ground root, three base rubble meshes and fourteen vegetation meshes. Their old counts and faceted topology are observations, not design locks.
observations.target: Keeps the lime/leaf-green fronds and cobalt base identity. Fronds read as flowing tapered volumes, with softened bends and broad luminous edges. Blue rubble has cleaner rounded bevels and a few purposeful pebbles. The target's apparent increase in stalk thickness and base height is aesthetic guidance only, not measurement authority.
observations.styleReference: Broad rounded leaves, saturated but separated green planes, warm soft reflection at edges, smooth material transitions and readable larger shapes. The requested outcome is soft cartoon volume with purposeful shape hierarchy, not a material-only repaint.
observations.risks: Avoid uniform neon yellow edges, noisy microdetail, black cavities, merged central fronds, disconnected roots, hard zigzag creases or unnatural pop at loop closure. Single-view ImageGen target cannot establish camera registration, back views or physical contact. Do not reproduce its edge halo.
